question:
Read the below statements marked as Assertion (A) and Reason (R). Mark the correct option:

Assertion (A): Industrial licensing was largely removed under the New Economic Policy of 1991.

Reason (R): Licensing was strengthened to curb private monopolies.

options.text: Both A and R are true and R explains A
Both A and R are true but R does not explain A
A is true but R is false
A is false but R is true

solution:
The correct answer is __**Option 3**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Industrial licensing was largely removed under the New Economic Policy (NEP) of 1991 to encourage market-driven growth and reduce bureaucratic hurdles.
 
• The NEP of 1991 introduced liberalization, aiming to reduce government control over industries and enhance competition in the private sector.
 
• The Reason (R) stating "Licensing was strengthened to curb private monopolies" is incorrect because the NEP sought to dismantle excessive control, not strengthen it.
 
• The removal of licensing was intended to attract foreign investments and promote economic efficiency in domestic industries.
 
• The NEP of 1991 marked a significant shift from the socialist model to a more liberalized and globalized economy, which included reducing the importance of industrial licensing.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: Both A and R are true and R explains A**

 
 
• This option is incorrect because while Assertion (A) is true, Reason (R) is false.
 
• Industrial licensing under the NEP of 1991 was reduced, but not to curb private monopolies. Instead, it aimed to promote competition and reduce government interference.
 
 
 
• **Option 2: Both A and R are true but R does not explain A**
 
 
• This option is also incorrect as Reason (R) is false.
 
• The NEP of 1991 focused on liberalizing industrial policies, and the assertion regarding licensing is true, but the reason provided does not align with the policy objectives.
 
 
 
• **Option 4: A is false but R is true**
 
 
• This option is incorrect because Assertion (A) is true, and Reason (R) is false.
 
• Licensing was not strengthened under the NEP; instead, it was dismantled to foster liberalization and globalization.
 
 
 
• **Theme of the Question: New Economic Policy of 1991**
 
 
• The NEP of 1991 was a landmark policy reform by the Indian government aimed at liberalizing the economy.
 
• Key features included reducing trade barriers, opening up the economy to foreign investment, deregulating industries, and reducing the role of the public sector.
 
• The policy marked the beginning of economic liberalization in India, steering the country towards globalization and market-driven growth.
